title: RELX Essential Starter Kit Bundle
description:
Overwhelmed by flavour options, or just looking to try something new? Our Kit Bundles package together devices with popular flavours to give you savings on your new vape kit! We select the pod flavours from our top sellers but they are also influenced by staff favorites and seasonal inspiration. Bundle flavours change periodically.

Jan 2025 Bundle

- 1 Relx Essential Device

- RELX PRO POD Grape Apple x 2 pods

- RELX PRO POD Pineapple Passionx 2 pods

- Savings of $1.49 on top of clearance pricing

The RELX Essential Device Kit works with all REXL Pro and RELX PRO 2 pods. As it is light, easy to use and inexpensive, the RELX ESSENTIAL KIT a great option for anyone interested in testing out the RELX Pro pod system. RELX is know for their unique pre-filled pod flavours and refreshing menthol finish. If you do not like frozen or menthol vape flavours, we recommend you explore our S-Pod or VUSE pod systems.

The RELX Essential Kit Bundle includes one RELX Essential Device Kit and 2 packs of Pods. Only available for online purchase. As of January 2025, all of our RELX PRO pods are on clearance. The device in this bundle is compatible with all RELX Pod Pro 2 flavours. Bundle price has been adjusted to provide a discount on top of the reduced device and pod prices.
